Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] governor [[John G. Rowland]] won reelection to a third consecutive term, defeating [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Bill Curry (politician)|Bill Curry]]. Rowland became the first [[List of governors of Connecticut|Connecticut governor]] to win a third term in office, but did not finish his term, resigning in 2004 due to allegations of corruption. Despite losing this election, Curry is to date the last Democratic gubernatorial candidate to carry [[Windham County, Connecticut|Windham County]]. ==General election== ===Candidates=== ====Democratic==== *[[Bill Curry (politician)|Bill Curry]], [[Counselor to the President]] under Clinton Administration, nominee in 1994 **Running mate: [[George Jepsen]], [[Connecticut Senate|Connecticut state senator]] ====Republican==== *[[John G.
